subject: Vendr bulk evidence manifest + S3 presigned upload checklist
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: BrightCloud Security <security@brightcloud.com>, Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr bulk evidence manifest + S3 presigned upload checklist

Hi Jane / Vendr team —

Thanks again for walking through the portal kickoff yesterday. BrightCloud is trying to accelerate the evidence hand-off for their SIG/CAIQ collection and agreed we should use Vendr’s bulk upload flow. To make the upload as painless as possible we need a small checklist and a sample manifest that maps our internal artifact IDs to the portal fields (control id, evidence type, file name, doc date).

Can you confirm the following for BrightCloud:
- Max file size per upload and per archive (we expect some .ppt/.xlsx files up to ~40 MB)
- Whether you accept nested directories in a zip (or do you require a flat manifest)
- Preferred manifest columns for CAIQ vs SIG imports (you can send two sample manifests)
- Whether presigned S3 uploads are available for vendors that prefer to push directly to an upload bucket
- Any content-type / filename constraints that typically cause rejections when the portal ingests artifacts

I’ve attached a simple manifest template (evidence-manifest-template.csv) and a short note of what we currently bundle. If you support presigned uploads, please share your bucket prefix and TTL recommendations; we can generate one-time presigned links from our S3 and have BrightCloud push artifacts directly.

Next steps we propose from our side: we’ll populate the manifest, stage a 100-file sample set, and request a verification ingest.

CCing Neha to coordinate the manifest mapping and Evelyn for SOC 2 evidence scoping.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: evidence-manifest-template.csv (CSV, 2KB), s3-presigned-instructions.pdf (PDF, 10KB)

From: Jane Dobson <jane.d@brightcloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr bulk evidence manifest + S3 presigned upload checklist

Hi Kim —

Great to sync yesterday — happy to get this moving. Quick answers inline and a couple of notes: 

- Max file size: portal accepts single files up to 50 MB. If you have larger artifacts, we prefer a zip (we accept up to 250 MB per zip).
- Directory structure: we prefer a flat manifest; nested zips are fine but the manifest should reference the top-level filename inside the zip.
- Manifest columns: our uploader accepts the following minimal set: control_id, evidence_id, evidence_type, filename, date_collected, claim_text, notes. For CAIQ imports we recommend adding caiq_control_id and caiq_category; for SIG add sig_question_id. I’ll attach two sanitized sample manifests.
- Presigned S3 uploads: yes — we can consume presigned PUTs. If you will host presigned links, share the expected prefix and we’ll validate the signatures. TTL: 24 hours is standard; up to 72 hours can be accommodated for larger transfers.
- Content constraints: filenames should avoid comma/newline characters and be UTF-8. Prefer common extensions (.pdf/.docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.png/.jpg/.zip).

I’ve also opened a support ticket on Vendr to enable a temporary ingestion queue for BrightCloud so your verification upload doesn’t mix with production imports: Vendr Ticket 78921.

I’ll attach the sample manifests and a small mapping doc. If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min validation window next week where we ingest the first 100 files and confirm metadata alignment.

Thanks,
Jane Dobson
Head of InfoSec Ops, BrightCloud
---
Attachments: brightcloud-manifest-sample-caiq.csv (CSV), brightcloud-manifest-sample-sig.csv (CSV)

From: Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Jane Dobson <jane.d@brightcloud.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr bulk evidence manifest + S3 presigned upload checklist

Hi all —

Thanks for the details — we’ve toggled the BrightCloud ingestion queue and validated the sample manifests provided by Jane. A couple of operational notes for Kim/Neha: 

- API rate limits for bulk validation: 10 manifest validations / minute; bulk ingest endpoints allow up to 5 concurrent upload jobs per account.
- Presigned PUTs: we will accept AWS V4 signature presigned PUT URLs. Please ensure the Content-Type header is set during upload; our verifier checks mime-type against file extension.
- Verification step: after you POST the manifest to /api/v1/bulk/validate, our service will return a CSV with per-file status and a short error code if something fails. Please use the validation endpoint before triggering /api/v1/bulk/ingest.
- Required metadata: evidence_id must be unique across uploads. If you have internal IDs, include a legacy_id column and we’ll preserve it as metadata.
- Security: we rotate the ingest bucket keys daily; presigned uploads must be created within 2 hours of the ingest window start for our scheduler to pick them up.

We’re attaching a short checklist (s3-presigned-instructions.pdf) and a curl-based example for manifest submission. If you want, we can also generate a temporary test prefix (vendr-validation/brightcloud-test/) that we’ll remove after the verification ingest.

Regards,
Vendr Support Team
---
Attachments: s3-presigned-instructions.pdf (PDF)

Note: the message above includes an example validation curl command. For large uploads consider the multipart S3 client to avoid intermittent failures.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jane Dobson <jane.d@brightcloud.com>, Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr bulk evidence manifest + S3 presigned upload checklist

Thanks Jane & Vendr — this is exactly what we needed.

Action items I’ll own from Redwood:
- Neha will build the manifest export from our evidence tracker and push a 100-file sample to the vendr-validation/brightcloud-test/ prefix by Monday 21 Jun (Neha, please confirm ETA).
- We’ll create presigned PUTs with 24-hour TTL and provide a manifest that references the exact filenames.
- Evelyn — can you confirm any SOC 2-specific evidence buckets we should prioritize during the validation ingest? Recommend control families: CC6, CC7, and CC10 for the first pass.

Jane — if Vendr can enable the validation queue and provide the temporary prefix, we’ll proceed Monday. We’ll also paste the manifest URL into the Jira ticket SECOPS-442 so all artifacts are centralized.

One quick note for the manifest template: we included a "legacy_id" column for BrightCloud’s internal mapping and a "redwood_control_tag" column for our internal triage — we hope that’s acceptable.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
